name: Trustoo Widgets
author: Trustoo

sections.description:
Trustoo Widgets – Display your Trustoo Score and reviews on your website

With this plugin, it’s easier than ever to install the Trustoo Widgets on your WordPress website. Retrieve the code from your Trustoo Dashboard, install the plugin, and place widgets such as the Trustoo Score Widget and the Trustoo Review Widget anywhere on your site.

Trustoo Score Widget

This widget adds an icon with your company’s Trustoo Score to your website. Visitors immediately see your business is highly rated, which builds trust and strengthens your reputation.

Trustoo Review Widget

Your business probably gets reviewed on different platforms: Google, Trustpilot, Facebook or industry-specific sites. Wouldn’t it be great to show them all in one place? The Trustoo Review Widget automatically gathers your customer reviews and displays them right on your website.

Features

  • Three Widget Types: Score Widget, Score + Google Widget, and Review Widget
  • Gutenberg Blocks: Visual block editor with live preview and customization options
  • Shortcode Support: Easy-to-use shortcodes for posts, pages, and widgets
  • Display the widgets anywhere on your website
  • Show star ratings in Google search results
  • Increase your company’s visibility and credibility
  • Easily adjust the design to match your website via your Trustoo Dashboard or custom HTML
  • Works in every browser and on mobile
  • Straightforward installation process
  • Also available as Shortcode and Gutenberg Blocks

Widget Types

  1. Score Widget – Display your Trustoo score
  2. Score + Google Widget – Score widget with Google integration
  3. Review Widget – Display customer reviews

How does it work?

After installing and activating the plugin:

Request your API key in the Trustoo Dashboard and use the handy sliders to match the design with your website and branding. Download the plugin in WordPress, paste the code, and you’re done. The widget will instantly appear on your website. In your Trustoo Dashboard, you can select exactly what you want to display.

  1. Go to Settings → Trustoo Widgets
  2. Enter your Trustoo API Key
  3. Add widgets using Gutenberg blocks or shortcodes

Shortcodes

  • [trustoo_score] – Score Widget
  • [trustoo_score_google] – Score + Google Widget
  • [trustoo_reviews] – Review Widget

Customization

All widgets support customization through attributes:

[trustoo_score theme=”dark” size=”large”]
[trustoo_reviews theme=”dark”]

Third-Party Services

This plugin integrates with Trustoo services to display widgets on your website.

What is Trustoo?

Trustoo is a third-party service that aggregates and displays business ratings, reviews, and scores from multiple platforms. The service provides widgets that can be embedded on websites to showcase customer feedback and ratings.

What is it used for?

This plugin uses Trustoo services to:
* Display business scores and ratings
* Show customer reviews from multiple platforms
* Display Google ratings alongside Trustoo scores
* Provide customizable widgets that match your website’s design

What data is sent and when?

API Authentication (Backend)
* When: During plugin activation, API key validation, and when accessing the admin settings page
* Data Sent: Your API key (used for authentication only)
* Purpose: To verify your API key and retrieve your account information (client ID, provider name)

Note: No personal user data is collected or sent. Only Trustoo account identifiers and widget configuration preferences are transmitted.

Privacy and Terms

  • Privacy Policy: EN | NL
  • Terms of Service: EN | NL

By using this plugin, you agree to Trustoo’s privacy policy and terms of service.
sections.installation:
In your Trustoo Dashboard

  1. Log in to your Trustoo Dashboard, click Website Widgets, and select the widget you want to place on your website.
  2. Adjust the widget to your preferences, such as theme, display options, and style.
  3. Click WordPress Plugin and copy the generated key.

In your WordPress Dashboard

  1. Go to Dashboard → Plugins → Add New Plugin
  2. Search for Trustoo Widgets
  3. Click Install
  4. Paste the API code from your Trustoo Dashboard
  5. Activate the plugin
  6. Place the widget anywhere on your site
sections.faq:
How do I install the plugin?

Follow the installation instructions or watch the instruction video for a visual walkthrough.

Is the plugin free?

Yes, the plugin is completely free with a Trustoo account.

Can I change how the widget looks on my website?

Yes, you can easily adjust the design in your Trustoo Dashboard (colors, style, and layout) so it perfectly matches your site.

Can I choose which reviews are shown?

Yes, you decide which reviews appear on your website.

Do I need a Trustoo account to use the widget?

Yes, creating and managing the widget is only possible with a Trustoo profile. Sign your company up in just a few minutes.

The widget isn’t working / I can’t install the plugin

If you need help installing the plugin, simply schedule a session with our customer service team. We’ll guide you step by step through installation or help fix any issues. Make sure you’re logged in to both your Trustoo Dashboard and your WordPress Dashboard.
